extracted.name: Kneecapper cocktail
extracted.description: This cocktail is based on a classic Bees Knees cocktail. Swap the gin for poitín – an Irish spirit – the sweet honey and zingy citrus accentuate the barley flavours in poitín
instruction_lines: Shake all the ingredients together and double strain into a sours or cocktail glass.
